DoubleVectorProperty.name: MinDistance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Minimum point distance in meters. Points closer than this are dropped.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MaxDistance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum point distance in meters. Points farther than this are dropped (0 or very large = no upper limit).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: StartAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Start of the azimuth FOV filter, in degrees [0,360].

DoubleVectorProperty.name: EndAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: End of the azimuth FOV filter, in degrees [0,360]. Supports wrap-around when EndAngle < StartAngle.
